name: whad-serial
description: WHAD serial dongle work from a Docker host with an nRF-style USB CDC-ACM device.

checks.name: docker-daemon
checks.description: Verify that the Docker daemon is available.

checks.name: serial-device-exists
checks.description: Verify that the selected WHAD serial device exists and is readable.

checks.name: whad-discovery
checks.description: Optionally verify that WHAD discovery can inspect the selected adapter.

host_requirements: Linux Docker host with the WHAD serial device passed through from the host or VM
nRF-style WHAD firmware already installed; this profile does not flash firmware
generated tools enable the crate WHAD feature before live serial use
authorized RF environment; run dry-run plans before live RF traffic
